 Cynthia Erivo Will Be a Guest Judge on Disney Night on Dancing With the Stars 
 TV News Cynthia Erivo Will Be a Guest Judge on Disney Night on Dancing with the Stars 
 Heather Headley, Michael James Scott, Kyra Belle Johnson, and Rodney Ingram will be guest performers.
 Linda Buchwald 
 | 
 Los Angeles 
 | 
 October 29, 2026 
 Cynthia Erivo 
(© Tricia Baron) 
 On the next episode of Dancing With the Stars , the remaining eight couples will perform to Disney songs from stage adaptations on “Disney Night.” Grammy, Emmy, and Tony winner Cynthia Erivo will be the guest judge.
 This week’s episode will air on Monday night, November 2, due to election night on Tuesday, on ABC and Disney+.
 The couples will perform the following songs and styles:
-Amber Glenn and partner Pasha Pashkov will perform a quickstep to “A Star Is Born” from Hercules 
-Maura Higgins and partner Mark Ballas will perform a jive to “You Can Fly! You Can Fly! You Can Fly!” from Peter Pan
 -Tatyana Ali and partner Jan Ravnik will perform a contemporary to “Easy As Life” from Aida , with guest artist Heather Headley performing live
-Harry Shum Jr. and partner Jenna Johnson will perform a jazz to “Supercalifragilisticexpialidocious” from Mary Poppins , with guest artist Kyra Belle Johnson performing live
-Ezra Frech and partner Daniella Karagach will perform a samba to “Under the Sea” from The Little Mermaid , with guest artist Michael James Scott performing live
-Julia Stiles and partner Ezra Sosa will perform a paso doble to “Satisfied” from Hamilton 
-Jenna Dewan and partner Val Chmerkovskiy will perform a quickstep to “Be Our Guest” from Beauty and the Beast , with guest artist Rodney Ingram performing live
-Connor Wood and partner Rylee Arnold will perform a waltz to “I See the Light” from Tangled , with guest artist Heather Headley performing live
 In addition to the competitive dances, pro and troupe members will perform routines to “Circle of Life/Nants Ingonyama” from The Lion King , “Belle” from Beauty and the Beast , “Seize the Day” from Newsies , “The Greatest Show” from The Greatest Showman , and “Friend Like Me” from Aladdin .
 There will also be team dances to “Zoo” from Zootopia 2 , performed by host Alfonso Ribeiro with Tatyana and Jan, Maura and Mark, Amber and Pasha, and Julia and Ezra, and “We’re All In This Together” from High School Musical , performed by host Julianne Hough with Connor and Rylee, Ezra and Dani, Jenna and Val, and Harry and Jenna.
